import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, random
z='../decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip'
out='/tmp/jpegs9'; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
    names=[n for n in f.namelist() if n.endswith('.jpg')]
    for n in random.sample(names, 10):
        p=os.path.join(out, os.path.basename(n))
        open(p,'wb').write(f.read(n))
        r=subprocess.run(['timeout','1s','./fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x', p], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(n, r.returncode)
